overall: GOOD this afternoon on most grounds; MARGINAL again at the 6–8 PM pickup
limiterDetail: The main limiter is current in the south and west at the pickups, plus overnight wind in the west. Wind now is 4.3–10.9 kt (gusts 8–15) and easing by evening on the Coron side. Tonight it builds to 13–16 kt at Nangalao and 13–14 kt at Cabunlawan, Decabaitot and Barangonan, while Coron, Galoc and Culion drop to about 4 kt. Rain is not a factor: dry, with 24h totals 0.0–3.3 mm (Barangonan gets light showers about 6–8 AM Tue). The current picks up about 4–9 PM (peak 6–8 PM), goes slack about 10 PM–3 AM , picks up again about 5–10 AM Tue , then eases from about 11 AM.

changed.title: ⚠️ What changed since this morning
items: No material change to supply: arrivals stay normal through Wednesday. We are in the midday easy-current window, so the grounds read 10 GOOD / 6 MARGINAL / 0 POOR / 0 VERY POOR right now (was 4 / 6 / 5 / 1 at 6 AM during the pickup). Ten grounds are GOOD; Tara, Nangalao, Cabunlawan, Decabaitot, Turda and Barangonan are MARGINAL.

Week shifts: Tue 27 is even calmer (4.6 kt, gusts 9, dry; was 5.0 kt, gusts 12). Thu 29 is wetter (12 kt, gusts 18, 9.7 mm; was 7.1 mm). Fri 30 is now mostly dry (9.0 kt, gusts 18; was 2.4 mm). Sat 31 rain is back up to moderate (11.2 mm; was 4.2 mm) , though wind stays light (5.0 kt). Sun 1 is 7.8 kt, gusts 17, 4.8 mm. PAGASA has nothing for Palawan.
